rust_summary:
a client mod's view and its own items (`native_raycast`, `native_view_hit`,
`native_claim_items`, `native_poll`).
doc_summary: a client mod's view and items: `native_raycast(distance)` and `native_view_hit()` (the first block along the view, up to 1024 blocks, across the distant terrain past the loaded chunks), and `native_claim_items(mod_id, ids)`: a right-click with one of those items is the mod's alone, the server never hears of it, and `native_poll(mod_id)` gives `UseStart` and `UseStop` with the stack (its custom name and data as SNBT) and the ticks it was held. Bundles need `"hooks": @API:native_claimed_items@`.
